stem: Which approach to antibiotic prophylaxis is most consistent with current guidance for dental patients at risk for infection, including those with special health care needs?

options.text: Give prophylaxis routinely to every patient with a special health care need, regardless of individual risk.
Decide on prophylaxis individually for each patient, recommending it for those at high risk of adverse outcomes from bacteremia who undergo invasive procedures.
Withhold prophylaxis from patients at high risk of adverse outcomes from bacteremia, even for invasive procedures.
For a patient with compromised immunity, decide independently without consulting the physician.
